title: UberLLM: cheap LLM, image and video API marketplace
description: UberLLM is one OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API key for Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and other text, image, video, music and speech models, usually below list price. Each request is served by a third-party provider and billed what that provider charged, from prepaid credit. No UberLLM fee on requests. Adding credit by card costs 5.5% + $0.50.
